doc.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Cafe Bohemia and Miles Davis in 1956
summary: On arriving in New York she went to Cafe Bohemia to hear Miles Davis and Philly Joe Jones, and recalls Paul Bley knowing Bill Evans.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: I hadn’t heard that yet. Not until I went to New York. When I went to New York that was a totally different story. It becomes a different... it’s almost like the curtain opens right now. When I got to New York I stopped at Cafe Bohemia for Miles Davis and Philly Joe Jones, and I think Wynton Marsalis, no... Fred Karlin? And... oh I temporarily forget who the tenor player was... but Steve’s favorite bass player....
Was it Wynton Kelly on piano?
No, I think it was... no, maybe it was Wynton Kelly, I didn’t know who the piano player was. I was just watching him... again as excited as I had heard Lionel Hampton.
What year was that? Maybe I can fill in that?
It’s like Bill Evans maybe? Cause Bill played with the band...
no definitely not this was much later.
Oh ’56, ok, cause ’59 is when Bill, of course.
I was in New York by then, and I knew Bill because Paul Bley knew him. Yeah when he joined Miles I was already going to Birdland a lot.
